$comment: Game time, PRD section 2. A day lasts about as long as a brig's real day's run (~115 tiles at ~4.5 tiles/s): 771 ticks at 30 per second is about 26 s at 1x, 13 s at the default 2x cruise. The sailing pace is 0.7 of the original, so the day is 1/0.7 as long and voyages, seasons and every rate measured in days are unchanged.
